title: The Breakfast Club
tagline: Five strangers. One detention. Plenty of snacks.
about: Five very different students spend a Saturday detention together.
cue: Serve the snacks when everyone unpacks their lunch.
faces: Ration sheet. Something warm for the long watch.
Toasted triple-decker of leg ham, Swiss and cheddar with mustard mayo and pickles.
Crackers, cheese and salami for anyone who forgot their lunch.
Roasted tomato soup with cream, plus crustless peanut butter and jam sandwiches.
Her sugar and cereal sandwich, if you dare.
Fudgy dark chocolate brownies with a soft centre.
Fresh strawberries blended with vanilla ice cream.
Form LAB1984, rev. 1985. Return tray to the hatch. Rations subject to supply.

    StartersAndrew's triple-stack ham and cheeseToasted triple-decker of leg ham, Swiss and cheddar with mustard mayo and pickles, cut into fingers, with crunchy apple slices on the side.How to make it3 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp wholegrain mustard12 slices of white bread400g leg ham4 slices of Swiss cheese4 slices of cheddar8 dill pickle slices2 apples1 lemonMix the mayo with the wholegrain mustard.Toast the bread.Build four stacks: toast, sauce, ham and Swiss, toast, sauce, ham, cheddar and pickles, then toast.Press lightly, cut each into three fingers and pin with toothpicks.Slice the apples and toss with lemon juice to serve alongside.Bender's share plateCrackers, cheese and salami for anyone who forgot their lunch.How to make it80g crackers100g cheddar, cubed80g sliced salamiCube the cheddar.Arrange the crackers, cheddar and salami on a shared plate in the middle of the table.Claire's salmon sushi bentoThe lunch that horrifies BenderHow to make itAs written, serves 4Salmon and avocado maki with salmon nigiri, soy, wasabi and pickled ginger, packed neatly into a bento box like it's Saturday detention at Shermer High.Rinse 400g sushi rice, cook with 480ml water, then fold through 80ml rice vinegar mixed with 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt and cool.Lay rice over 3 nori sheets, add strips of salmon and avocado, roll tight with a mat and cut each into 8.Shape 8 small rice oblongs, dab with wasabi and top with sliced sashimi salmon.Pack into 4 bento boxes with soy, wasabi and pickled ginger.MainsBrian's lunchRoasted tomato soup with cream, plus crustless peanut butter and jam sandwiches.How to make it800g tomatoes1 brown onion, quartered3 garlic cloves1 tbsp olive oil500ml chicken stock80ml thickened cream8 slices of white bread80g peanut butter60g jamsalt and pepper, to tasteHalve the tomatoes and roast with the onion, garlic and oil at 200°C until softened and browned.Transfer to a pot with the stock and simmer.Blitz smooth with the cream and season. Pour into warmed thermoses.Make four peanut butter and jam sandwiches with the white bread, cut off the crusts and serve with the soup.Allison's cereal-crusted French toastHer sugar and cereal sandwich, if you dareHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thick brioche dipped in vanilla custard, crusted in crushed sweet cereal and fried golden in butter, with whipped cream, berries and maple syrup.Whisk 4 eggs, 250ml milk, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of cinnamon.Crush 120g sweet corn cereal into coarse crumbs.Dip 8 thick slices brioche in the custard for 20 seconds a side, then press both sides into the cereal.Fry in 40g butter over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and crunchy.Serve with whipped cream, berries and maple syrup.SweetsDetention browniesFudgy dark chocolate brownies with a soft centre and crisp edges.How to make it100g dark chocolate100g butter120g caster sugar2 eggs60g plain flourpinch of saltHeat the oven to 175°C and line an 18cm square tin. Melt the chocolate and butter gently and cool slightly.Whisk in the sugar and eggs, then fold in the flour and salt.Bake until the edges are set and the middle gently wobbles.Cool before cutting into four portions.DrinksDetention strawberry milkshakeFresh strawberries blended with vanilla ice cream and cold milk until thick and pink, topped with whipped cream and a fresh strawberry.How to make it250g strawberries6 scoops of vanilla ice cream500ml full cream milk1 tbsp caster sugar1 can whipped creamHull the strawberries, keeping four for garnish.Blend the rest with the ice cream, milk and sugar until thick and smooth.Pour into four tall glasses, top with whipped cream and a strawberry on the rim, and serve with straws.Ice cold Tab colaClaire's pick.
